Blush Sauce [BOOM 0106]

Prep: 10 minutes. Yield: 5 cups. Shelf life: 6 days. Allergen Call Out: Milk.

Ingredients

  • 660 g Pizza Sauce [BOOM 0002]
  • 285 g Heavy Whipping Cream
  • 285 g Galbani Ricotta Cheese
  • 30 g TILL Garlic Base [TILL008]
  • 3 g Kosher Salt

Method

  1. Combine all ingredients in a mixing bowl. Whisk thoroughly until the color is consistent with no streaks.
  2. Using a funnel, fill a 40 oz squeeze bottle to just below the neck. Transfer excess to an 8 oz deli container. Scrape the bowl with a rubber spatula.
  3. Label and date both containers. Rotate into stock.

LEAN Working

Stage the mixing bowl, whisk, rubber spatula and funnel together. Set out the bottle and deli container before mixing.

Before You Start

Gather tools and scale ingredients. Print 2 PrepWizard labels. Have a 40 oz squeeze bottle and an 8 oz deli container ready.
